svg.title: Usage matrix under two layouts, showing container activation and waste
svg.text: The same events, the same queries, two layouts
Rows are events grouped into containers · columns are queries · a container is opened when any of its rows is selected
Events placed wherever there was room when they arrived.
Events grouped by the queries that select them.
Within a container a column is all-filled or all-empty — that is what activation means. Waste is every red cell.
